description_good_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/README.md -- opening lines say what the software does.
interact_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/README.md#install-and-run and https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md -- how to get it, file issues, and contribute.
contribution_requirements_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#coding-standards -- named style guides and required gates.
floss_license_osi_justification: MIT is on the OSI-approved list.
license_location_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/LICENSE at the repo root; also vendored into the published npm tarball.
documentation_interface_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/README.md#install-and-run's flag table documents the CLI's external interface (argv in, files/exit-codes out).
sites_https_justification: GitHub and npmjs.com serve everything over HTTPS/TLS.
discussion_justification: GitHub Issues: searchable, addressable by URL, open to anyone, no proprietary client required.
english_justification: All docs are in English; issues/PRs in English are expected and supported.
maintained_justification: Actively maintained by a single maintainer; see recent commit history.
repo_track_justification: git tracks what changed, who, and when.
repo_interim_justification: Commits between releases are visible in git history, not only tagged releases.
repo_distributed_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork -- git, a common distributed VCS.
version_unique_justification: SemVer; each npm release has a unique version.
release_notes_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/packages/cli/CHANGELOG.md (changesets-generated) and each GitHub Release's notes -- human-readable, not a raw git log.
release_notes_vulns_justification: No CVE has ever been assigned against this project; there is no fixed vulnerability to list yet. SECURITY.md's response process commits to listing one if it happens.
report_process_justification: Bug reports are submitted via GitHub Issues: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/issues (see also CONTRIBUTING.md and the issue templates).
report_responses_justification: Single-maintainer project; issues and PRs are acknowledged promptly.
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement requests are triaged the same way as bug reports.
report_archive_justification: GitHub Issues is a public, searchable archive of every report and response: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/issues
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/SECURITY.md commits to acknowledgment within 7 days, under the criterion's 14-day bar.
build_justification: `pnpm build` (`tsc -b`) rebuilds automatically from source; see CLAUDE.md's Commands table.
build_common_tools_justification: TypeScript's `tsc` via pnpm -- a common toolchain for the language.
build_floss_tools_justification: tsc, pnpm, ESLint, Prettier, Vitest -- all FLOSS.
test_justification: Vitest test suite; `pnpm test` documented in CONTRIBUTING.md and CLAUDE.md.
test_invocation_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/package.json -- `pnpm test` / `pnpm test:coverage`, the standard way to run tests in this ecosystem.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml runs the suite on every push and PR.
tests_are_added_justification: Recent commits (e.g. the CLI input-validation fix) add tests alongside the behavior they cover.
tests_documented_added_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md and the PR template both state the policy.
warnings_justification: TypeScript `strict` plus extra flags, and ESLint's flat config with typescript-eslint's typed rules.
warnings_fixed_justification: The repo is currently warning-free under `eslint . --max-warnings 0`.
warnings_strict_justification: `pnpm lint` runs `eslint . --max-warnings 0` -- a warning fails the gate like an error.
know_common_errors_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md's CWE Top 25 table names vulnerability types and this project's mitigation for each.
crypto_published_justification: The project implements and uses no cryptography.
delivery_mitm_justification: Distributed only via the npm registry and git+https/ssh, both TLS-protected.
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hash is fetched over plain HTTP and used without a signature check anywhere in this project.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: SECURITY.md commits to fixing a confirmed medium+ vulnerability within 60 days; none is currently open.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: GitHub secret scanning and push protection are enabled; `.claude/hooks/guard-secret-writes.mjs` blocks a secret-shaped write during development.
static_analysis_justification: GitHub CodeQL (default setup) analyzes every push and PR -- more often than 'each release'.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL's default query suite covers common vulnerability classes (CWE-mapped).
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Confirmed static-analysis findings are fixed promptly; none currently open.
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL and ESLint both run on every commit via CI, not just daily.
dynamic_analysis_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dynamic-analysis -- fast-check property tests run on every push, PR, and pre-release `pack` job.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: TypeScript/JavaScript on Node's managed runtime -- no memory-unsafe code exists.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: `node:assert/strict` invariants at the trust boundaries named in https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md run live during the property-test suite.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: A property-test failure fails `pnpm test`, which gates every PR and the pre-release `pack` job; no finding can ship unfixed.
dco_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin -- every commit needs a Signed-off-by trailer, enforced by the commit-msg hook.
bus_factor_justification: Honestly 1 today; see https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#bus-factor. MUST at Gold, requiring 2+; growing past 1 is on https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/ROADMAP.md.
documentation_current_justification: Docs are updated in the same PR as the code/behavior they describe (CONTRIBUTING.md's PR checklist); no known stale-doc defect is open.
documentation_achievements_justification: Not yet registered for this badge, so there is nothing to link yet -- will be added to README.md within 48 hours of the badge being issued.
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: No custom UI; all human-facing surfaces are plain-text CLI output or GitHub/npmjs.com's own hosted pages.
internationalization_justification: The CLI has no localizable end-user text -- its output is developer-facing status/error text only.
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: No vulnerability report has been resolved yet. SECURITY.md#credit commits to crediting reporters when one is.
coding_standards_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#coding-standards names TypeScript strict, ESLint, Prettier, and Conventional Commits.
coding_standards_enforced_justification: `pnpm verify`, pre-commit/pre-push hooks, and CI all enforce it automatically.
build_standard_variables_justification: No native build; `tsc` compiles TypeScript, with no CC/CFLAGS/LDFLAGS-equivalent convention.
build_preserve_debug_justification: Not applicable to a typical JavaScript/TypeScript build.
build_non_recursive_justification: Not applicable to a typical JavaScript/TypeScript build (`tsc -b` project references, not recursive make).
build_repeatable_justification: `pack.e2e.test.ts` asserts the packed tarball emits byte-identical output to the source checkout.
installation_common_justification: `npx @monte3l/groundwork@rc <dir>` -- the standard way to run an npm-published CLI; README notes npx leaves nothing installed globally.
installation_standard_variables_justific: Installed and run via npx; there is no DESTDIR-style install-location convention for this kind of package.
external_dependencies_justification: Every dependency is listed in machine-readable form in package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/package.json (packages/cli declares zero runtime dependencies).
dependency_monitoring_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/.github/workflows/dependency-review.yml fails a PR on a high-severity finding; GitHub CodeQL and Dependabot alerts cover the rest.
updateable_reused_components_justificati: A committed lockfile pins every dependency version; Dependabot tracks GitHub Actions majors.
interfaces_current_justification: typescript-eslint's typed rules and manual review keep the codebase off deprecated APIs.
automated_integration_testing_justificat: CI runs the full suite (including e2e) on every push/PR and reports pass/fail per job.
regression_tests_added50_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#scope-of-a-pr now makes this a formal MUST; the CLI input-validation fix is a recent example of a bug fix landing with its regression test.
test_statement_coverage80_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/vitest.config.ts's v8 coverage gate: 90% statement/line, 80% branch/function, per file.
crypto_credential_agility_justification: No embedded cryptographic credentials; npm publishing uses OIDC trusted publishing, not a stored key.
crypto_used_network_justification: The project writes no network-protocol code; the only network traffic (npm/git over HTTPS) is handled entirely by npm/git themselves.
signed_releases_justification: npm provenance (Sigstore-backed, OIDC-issued, no long-lived key) plus a build-provenance attestation attached to the GitHub Release; see https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-releases for verification instructions.
version_tags_signed_justification: Release tags are created by the changesets publish action and are lightweight/unsigned, though the commits they point at are GPG-signed. SUGGESTED only.
input_validation_justification: `parseArgs` allowlist-validates `--pack` and `--name` and rejects an invalid value with a usage error before any filesystem access.
hardening_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml -- every workflow resets permissions to the minimum needed per job, `persist-credentials: false` on every checkout, every Action pinned by SHA, and npm publishing gated behind a required-reviewer environment plus 2FA-gated staged publish.
contributors_unassociated_justification: All non-trivial contribution to date is from the maintainer; see https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#gold-level-criteria-this-project-does-not-meet.
copyright_per_file_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/REUSE.toml plus an inline `SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright the m3l-groundwork contributors` header on every tracked source file outside `templates/**` (the baseline this CLI emits into other people's projects, deliberately excluded -- see REUSE.toml's own comment). Checked by `bin/check-license-headers.mjs`.
license_per_file_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/REUSE.toml plus an inline `SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT` header on the same files as copyright_per_file. Checked by `bin/check-license-headers.mjs`, part of `pnpm verify`'s `lint` group.
require_2FA_justification: The `monte3l` GitHub organization requires two-factor authentication for every member; see https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#account-security.
secure_2FA_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#account-security -- TOTP or a hardware key required; SMS explicitly excluded.
two_person_review_justification: With one maintainer, no proposed change can be reviewed by a second human before release; see https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#gold-level-criteria-this-project-does-not-meet. `claude-pr-review.yml`'s automated comment is real review signal but not a substitute for the criterion's own "a person other than the author" wording.
build_reproducible_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/packages/cli/tests/pack.e2e.test.ts's reproducible-build case: two independent, clean `pnpm build && pnpm pack` runs produce a byte-identical tarball. See also https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reproducing-a-release.
test_statement_coverage90_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/vitest.config.ts's v8 coverage gate: 90% statement/line coverage, per file.
test_branch_coverage80_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/vitest.config.ts's v8 coverage gate: 80% branch coverage, per file.
hardened_site_justification: GitHub (repository) and npmjs.com (download site) both serve CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and X-Frame-Options -- verified with `curl -sI` against https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork and https://www.npmjs.com/package/@monte3l/groundwork.
security_review_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/docs/security-review.md -- reviewed and signed off by the maintainer on 2026-09-26, considering the security requirements and boundary from docs/assurance-case.md.
